evaluation_process: Systematically evaluated English-speaking countries with GDP between $200B and $1T USD nominal (2023-2024) against criteria for 'just starting to incorporate AI'. Prioritized direct outputs from advisory agents and detailed web search findings for AI adoption status and competitive landscape of B2B AI/custom software agencies. Re-evaluated countries with nuanced adoption profiles to ensure strict adherence to 'just starting' criterion. Resolved GDP and English official language data inconsistencies to ensure reliable selection. Confirmed 'high density and volume' and 'crowded and active competitive landscape' through lists of agencies and market growth statistics.
